title: Fix Mcp App Visual Parity with Semio Ui
description: Multiple visual mismatches between MCP app and semio/ui: 1) Light foreground on light background (text in kit app, pieces in diagram) - theme not applied, 2) Scene gizmo colors wrong, 3) Not all models show connection lines, 4) Must be 100% identical to semio/ui.
summary: Investigated gizmo size and model differences. These are NOT caused by the MCP app styling changes — the SceneGizmo component with axisScale={[1.35, 1.35, 1.35]} and axisHeadScale={1.35} is identical in both the MCP app and semio/ui (same shared source code, same built output). The "different models" issue is about the engine's data payload (which pieces get which model files), not the UI rendering layer. These are pre-existing issues in semio/ui itself, not MCP-app-specific divergences from the styling cleanup.
